# Cisco skill-scanner eval fixtures

Copied unmodified from https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/skill-scanner @ 8554b119bd118583f1a235e4e7aad8f2005ef904
(evals/skills and evals/test_skills), Apache-2.0 (LICENSE in this folder), Copyright Cisco Systems, Inc.
The repository describes evals/skills cases as "first-party human-reviewed inert fixture"s. runthrough has not
audited every case for inertness, so nothing here is ever executed; tests only read the files.
Each case's expected outcome is in its _expected.json.
